feed.title: NPR Topics: Home Page Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories in the U.S. and world news, politics, health, science, business, music, arts and culture. Nonprofit journalism with a mission. This is NPR.

entry.title: The incoming class of U.S. senators is full of historic firsts
entry.summary: From the first Native American elected to the U.S. Senate and the first Muslim who will join the upper chamber to the Senate's first Paralympian, voters elected historic candidates in the midterms.

entry.title: Trump's global health strategy is emerging. What will the Democratic Congress say?
entry.summary: The Trump Administration has ushered in a fundamental shift in the U.S. approach to global health aid. How will the newly elected Democratic Congress weigh in?

entry.title: No one knows how many ballots are outstanding in Mississippi's Senate race
entry.summary: The razor-thin margin between GOP Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith and Democrat Scott Colom is shining a light on an election process in Mississippi that is among the slowest and most decentralized in the U.S.

entry.title: Stephen Miller will replace Susie Wiles as Trump's chief of staff
entry.summary: The change comes after sweeping Republican losses in the midterm elections.

entry.title: Pope Leo begins a 12-day, 3-country South America tour after his cancer surgery
entry.summary: Pope Leo begins his first South American tour since lung cancer surgery. The 12-day journey takes him to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru, where he spent two decades.

entry.title: Health intel-sharing group warns industry in wake of cyberattack on French blood bank
entry.summary: A healthcare intelligence-sharing organization is warning its members to lock down systems following cyberattacks on cold storage systems, including a French blood bank.

entry.title: 'Club Kid' dances to the rhythm of its own drum and bass
entry.summary: There's every reason to be wary of Club Kid, one of those manchild-must-grow-up-when-a-cute-kid-shows-up stories. But Jordan Firstman's directorial debut is different.

entry.title: 'Wild Horse Nine' turns CIA dirty work into a tiresome tale of bickering tourists
entry.summary: John Malkovich and Sam Rockwell star as CIA agents trying to topple Chilean democracy who take a side trip to Easter Island. Brace yourself for oddball twists, jolts of violence and profanity galore.

entry.title: European flights and broadcasters are targeted with another wave of bomb threats
entry.summary: Officials across Europe reported a slew of bomb threats against multiple flights, following a string of hoaxes that caused flight diversions this week. Three broadcasters also received threats.

entry.title: The leader of a Kenyan doomsday cult is sentenced to 200 years in prison
entry.summary: Cult leader Paul Mackenzie was convicted of murdering 190 children and one adult after he ordered his followers to starve themselves to death in order to meet Jesus.
